name: Wigwoof
look: a light green wolf pup with a big blond bowl of hair like a wig, orange eyes, a brown nose, a little fang and a bushy dark green tail tipped yellow
entry: The blond tuft on its head is a clump of dry grass it never stops growing. It hides its eyes under it when it is shy, and fluffs it up to look bigger when it wants to look tough.
how: One of the A. Fakemon starters: pick it at the starter screen (its own A. Fakemon page).
Wild: very rare in forests and plains.
